wallpaper.formula: total_sqft = sum(convert_to_sqft(width * height) for each wall); price = total_sqft * material_rate + installation + removal + design

window_graphics.formula: total_sqft = sum(convert_to_sqft(width * height) for each panel); price = total_sqft * material_rate + installation + removal + design

vehicle_wrap.pricing_note: Pricing must be editable from admin/backend.
